import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storyline/claimAllChests/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 一键领取所有章节宝箱
 * /一键领取宝箱
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const resultMd = Format.createMarkdown();
    const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
    const result = await App({ uid, bid, request });

    if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
      throw new Error(result.data.message);
    }

    if (result.data.success) {
      resultMd.addText(`🎁 ${result.data.message}`);
      resultMd.addNewline();
      resultMd.addNewline();

      for (const detail of result.data.details) {
        resultMd.addText(`第${detail.chapterNumber}章 ${detail.chapterName}：宝箱×${detail.claimed.length}，灵晶×${detail.reward}`);
        resultMd.addNewline();
      }
    } else {
      const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, '一键领取宝箱', `❌ ${result.data.message}`, request);

      resultMd.addText(failMsg);
    }

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false,
        bid,
        title: '副本 - 一键领取宝箱',
        header: [
          { label: '返回', command: '/查看主线' },
          { label: '秘境', command: '/查看秘境' }
        ],
        content: resultMd
      })
    );
  } catch (_error) {
    logger.error('一键领取宝箱失败:', _error);

    const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    errMd.addText('❌ 领取失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false,
        bid,
        title: '副本 - 一键领取宝箱',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/查看主线' }],
        content: errMd
      })
    );
  }
});
